title: Fix issue #146: the architecture gate drops reverse edges for $id-based and file#fragment contract references, so a changed contract is never re-verified against the dependents that reference it through those grammars. Make the closure resolve the same reference grammar the comparator resolves, with regression coverage for an $id edge, a fragment edge and the plain-relative control; do not change comparator semantics, compatibility policy or any contract.
